research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Clumio is researching methods for cloud-based data protection and backup, as shown by work on protection groups for backing up cloud-based key-value stores, which enables rapid determination of expired objects and efficient management of storage resources. Additionally, they are developing data protection services using isolated, encrypted backup data to enhance security for organizational data. These areas reflect Clumio’s focus on secure, efficient cloud backup and data management.

product_launches.description: Clumio, a Commvault company, launched 'Clumio for Google Cloud', extending its cloud-native cyber resilience SaaS platform to protect and recover large-scale datasets in Google Cloud Storage, with early access available now and GA targeted for summer 2026.

overview_description.description:
Clumio delivers cloud-based data protection and backup services tailored to enterprise needs. They offer a platform that provides backup (BaaS) service for various cloud environments, including AWS, VMware Cloud on AWS, and Microsoft 365.

Clumio aims to simplify data protection by offering a unified backup solution spanning on-premises data centers and cloud infrastructure. Their platform is designed to be scalable, efficient, and easy to manage. It leverages cloud-native technologies to provide backup, recovery, and compliance features.
